description: Conservative metadata derived from DRSTool's bundled env_vars.json; not online verified.

DXVK_FRAME_RATE.note: Forks may retain support; no claim is made for unknown forks or intervening versions.

DXVK_STATE_CACHE.note: Legacy flag; catalog says modern upstream no longer uses state cache, but provides no exact removal version.

DXVK_STATE_CACHE_PATH.note: Legacy state-cache path; no verified removal boundary in bundled metadata.

DXVK_ASYNC.evidence: env_vars.json: DXVK_ASYNC description / linter fork note

PROTON_DXVK_LLASYNC.note: Requires a compatible Proton/DXVK fork; 'fork' alone does not prove it is implemented.

DXVK_FRAME_PACE.note: Specific to dxvk-low-latency or DXVK-Sarek, with different supported modes.

PROTON_DXVK_LOWLATENCY.note: Bundled catalog says proton-cachyos exposes this switch; other forks need checking.
